text: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA), which invests on behalf of the Government of Abu Dhabi, held a 9.8% minority stake in TeamSystem as of July 2026 (per a corporate filing reported by Reuters), after a wholly owned ADIA subsidiary agreed in August 2023 to acquire a minority stake from Hellman & Friedman.

source.name: Reuters (republished by Global Banking & Finance Review): Francisco Partners, KKR to buy minority stakes in Italy's TeamSystem, sources say
source.quote: Silver Lake and Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund ADIA, which acquired stakes in TeamSystem from H&F in 2023, owned 12.8% and 9.8%, respectively.
source.note: Reuters article by Elvira Pollina and Amy-Jo Crowley; reuters.com copy not directly fetchable for scripts, republished here in full. Same article: H&F held 69% as of July 2026 per the filing.

additionalSources.name: Hellman & Friedman press release: ADIA and CapitalG to Invest in TeamSystem
additionalSources.quote: a wholly owned subsidiary of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) and CapitalG, Alphabet's independent growth fund, have entered into definitive agreements to acquire minority stakes in TeamSystem
additionalSources.note: Same page: ADIA is 'a globally-diversified investment institution that prudently invests funds on behalf of the Government of Abu Dhabi'; H&F 'will remain the majority shareholder'; deals to close Q1 2024. hf.com blocks script access (HTTP 403); the same URL was read via its Wayback Machine snapshot of 18 April 2025 (https://web.archive.org/web/20250418095156/https://hf.com/adia-and-capitalg-to-invest-in-teamsystem/), where the quote appears verbatim.
